magari.consejo: It expresses a wish or a contingent possibility.

texto: **Ti va una pizza?** (do you want a pizza?); **Ti va di venire?** (do you want to come?); **Vuoi venire con me?** (do you want to come with me?).
The impersonal verb **andare a qualcuno** means «want to»: **Ti va?** (do you want it?), **Vi va?** (do you want it?).
To reject with delicacy: **Mi dispiace, non posso** (I'm sorry, I can't); **Purtroppo sono impegnato** (unfortunately I'm busy).

filas: Ti va un caffè? / Ti va di uscire?

bloques.titulo: Vocabulary: social relations, invitations and agreements

frases.it: Ti va una pizza stasera dopo il lavoro?
frases.es: ¿Te apetece una pizza esta noche después del trabajo?
frases.en: Would you like a pizza tonight after work?

frases.it: Volentieri! A che ora ci possiamo incontrare?
frases.es: ¡Con gusto! ¿A qué hora nos podemos encontrar?
frases.en: With pleasure! What time can we meet?

frases.it: Verso le otto davanti alla pizzeria centrale.
frases.es: A eso de las ocho delante de la pizzería central.
frases.en: About eight o'clock in front of the central pizzeria.

frases.it: Mi dispiace, a quell'ora sono impegnato in palestra.
frases.es: Lo siento, a esa hora estoy ocupado en el gimnasio.
frases.en: I'm sorry, I'm busy at the gym at that time.

frases.it: Nessun problema, possiamo vederci verso le nove!
frases.es: ¡Ningún problema, podemos vernos a eso de las nueve!
frases.en: No problem, we can see each other around 9: 00!

frases.it: Perfetto, allora ci vediamo alle nove in punto.
frases.es: Perfecto, entonces nos vemos a las nueve en punto.
frases.en: Perfect, then we'll see you at nine o'clock.

bloques.pregunta: What is the right construction to ask «Do you want to go out?»?

opciones.explicacion: «Ti va di + infinitive» is the fixed pattern for proposing an apt-tequable action.
«Ti va» is impersonal; it should not be conjugated in second person «vai».
The singular infinitive requires the singular «va» form.

bloques.pregunta: What expression does an educated apology make when an invitation is declined?

opciones.explicacion: «Mi dispiace» conveys sincere regret and courtesy in rejecting.
That response was useful in accepting the proposal.

opciones.explicacion: Fixed impersonal verbal form: «ti va una birra».
Second person of the verb «andare», not applicable to this deiderative turn.

opciones.texto: Invite to have a coffee in a relaxed and colloquial way.
opciones.explicacion: «Ti va di bere» opens a close and common social proposal in Italy.
